why: The answer depends on the self-reduction (bessemerisation) step of copper extraction, a metallurgy fact no chapter in the supplied list teaches.
note: Taxonomy gap: the expected chapter is 'General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Elements' (metallurgy: roasting, smelting, self-reduction, refining). The supplied list has no metallurgy chapter, and the p-Block chapter is not where this is taught. Separately, the item carries correct_answer '2' (sulphur dioxide); the self-reduction 2Cu2O + Cu2S -> 6Cu + SO2 makes Cu2S the reductant and SO2 a product, so the stored key looks wrong.
